name: EventViewer
tagline: Windows 11 Event Viewer, Unified Log & Diagnostic Suite
short_description: Windows Event Viewer clarity engineered natively for macOS Unified Logging. Stream System, Application, Security, Kernel, and Network channels in real time with split Windows XML & JSON inspection, a 3-column interactive Bezier Event Correlation Flow Map, Crash & EXC_GUARD Diagnostic Report Inspector, floating desktop HUD widgets, custom Menu Bar token builder with EV monogram badge, and 9 Low Effort themes.
spotlight_description: Windows 11 Event Viewer clarity combined with real-time macOS Unified Logging (`OSLogStore`), CrashReporter `.ips` forensics, and interactive 3-column Bezier Event Correlation Flow Maps. Features structured 5-channel categorization (System, Security & Auth, Application, Hardware & IOKit, Crash & Diagnostics), Windows Event XML + JSON dual payload inspector, custom modular desktop HUD widgets, custom Menu Bar token builder with embossed `EV` monogram badge, and 9 studio themes with live Dock icon switching.
catalog_description: Windows 11 Event Viewer clarity engineered natively in Swift 6 for macOS. Streams and categorizes macOS `OSLogStore` logs into 5 structured channels (System, Security & Auth, Application, Hardware & IOKit, Crash & Diagnostics) with deterministic Event IDs, Windows Event XML + JSON payload inspector, interactive 3-column Bezier Event Correlation Flow Map with 1-click process isolation, `.ips`/`.crash` DiagnosticReports parser, saved custom filter views, 5 desktop liquid-glass HUD widgets, custom Menu Bar token builder (`EV` monogram), and 9 themes.
